annotations.title: What will this US series do over the next 12 months?

description: Use when the user is setting a plan, budget or inventory for the next year and needs where US retail sales, prices (CPI), employment and wages, industrial production, housing or vehicle sales are heading. Returns a 12-month forecast with an 80% band, next to "same month last year", from a model backtested on the series' own last three years. Refuses before you are charged when last year's same month forecast it better, and says by how much. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.

series.description: The FRED series ID, e.g. RSXFSN (retail sales) or CPIAUCNS (CPI, all items). Not seasonally adjusted.
